digest.component_or_area: read CLI surfaces (show/list/search/ready) under concurrent write storm
propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) must produce parseable JSON output or exit nonzero when invoked under write-burst contention with concurrent background pushes.
Exit code 0 with truncated/empty stdout (distinct from valid-empty JSON serialization like []) indicates a stall or output-integrity bug and must fail the property test.
Every read invocation must clear the sync throttle marker before execution so the reconverge path is exercised rather than short-circuited to the local snapshot.

The property must hold under two scenarios: (A) repeated write bursts with background pushes and per-surface throttle clears, and (B) a deterministic held write lock forcing reads to wait on lock timeout.
The generalized property reuses the ed2b harness (repo_with_origin_tickets, _rebar_cli, _clear_sync_throttle) rather than duplicating per-surface test logic.
